name: Hornero Dual Clock
description: Dual Clock 2.0: local time next to a second zone (UTC by default, as in 1.x) in the bar, with a details popover. Pure-JS rule-based offsets, no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: tokens and variant names ported.
Popover: offset shown as +3:00 (was +3.00:00), short daylight-saving note that wraps inside the popout.
Suppress the indicator tooltip while its popover is open (it floated over the popover).

Native popout: subtitle header, caption date line and label/value detail rows (PluginKit UiDetailRow); DST folds into the zone row label. Needs Hornero Shell 1.2.74 (UiText subtitle, UiDetailRow, borderless UiPopover).

Time and Agenda 2.0: shared Time facade instead of an own timer, Theme tokens, keyboard-operable indicator with a details popover (locale dates, applied offsets, DST state, offset difference), selectable second zone defaulting to UTC with the identical 1.x label, typed settings and Argentine Spanish catalog.
Local time next to UTC in the bar for coordinating across time zones; themed text and vertical two-line layout.

secondZone.description: Zone shown on the second line (UTC in 1.x). Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

showSeconds.description: Show seconds on both lines (1.x showed HH:mm only).

twentyFourHour.description: Use 24-hour times (the 1.x behaviour); off shows 12-hour AM/PM.
